posts.t: It would be hard for others to make suggestions if no one new my particular style. typical review Daily & 4HR TF down to 1HR. Check 15min and trade from the 5min, exacting entries & PA from 1 min during trading hours. Due to my unfortunate time zone, I place my over night trades on the 15min. Hope that helps. Obvisously using PA as everything at supply & demand levels.
